subject: HANDOFF V2: preserve proven early physical wake; next candidate fixes Hall-opening lifetime, presentation ownership, and adds panel-state telemetry
body: Current field disposition after V1/V2 physical experiments: (1) preserve SW_LID/Hall as the earliest opening trigger; field delivery is sub-millisecond in normal cases and materially earlier than Samsung's native posture handoff; (2) preserve immediate physical INNER SurfaceControl power request; fresh V2 diagnostics show successful command receipts on every observed wake transaction; (3) do not wait for an early 1968x2184 logical route because the probe still finds none before Samsung topology migration; (4) correct semantic lifetime so a Hall-authenticated opening is not cancelled merely because Samsung transiently reports its intermediate folded posture; cancellation must require Hall-close/reversal/terminal service/privilege evidence or bounded no-progress timeout; (5) keep exact OpeningKey fencing and one-shot WAKE_COMMITTED; stale attempts must never cross into later openings; (6) presentation remains a separate stage. V2's native-stack near-black privacy cover plus 80 ms settle handoff removes the explicit temporary layer-stack switch, but current diagnostics still lack actual FIRST_PRESENTED/FIRST_USEFUL proof and the human reports possible intermittent dark cycles. Instrument and validate physical-confirmed -> bridge-presenting -> native-active -> first-useful before replacing the privacy bridge with the real fold renderer; (7) expose these states in the app for closed-device verification; (8) keep wallpaper alignment on a separate rendering lane. Five V2 attempts in the captured window reached HANDOFF_ARMED/HANDOFF_RELEASED (4,5,7,8,10); other Hall attempts demonstrate the segmentation defect. No Android runtime from the experiment branches has been merged into main. Main receives only these append-only AgentBus updates.
next_runtime_contract: survive transient Samsung folded posture after Hall-open
terminalize only on real close/reversal/terminal evidence or bounded no-progress timeout
add FIRST_PRESENTED/FIRST_USEFUL evidence before real transition-renderer bridge
